terms_id.description: Stable id for the agreement, echoed back in terms_response.

version.description: Agent-owned version label for this text, echoed back in terms_response. A string, not a date — the agent decides the scheme.

body.description: Full agreement text, markdown. The client currently renders it as plain text (see terms_handler.dart).

signing_level.description: What the agent asks for. What the device actually delivered comes back as terms_response.method, which may be a lower rung after fallback (drawn -> typed -> tap).

allow_decline.description: Defaults to true client-side — shows a Decline button that sends agreed: false.
